hints.title: Non-Zero Element Compression
hints.text: Store only indices where values are non-zero along with their non-zero values.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Merging of Pairs
hints.text: Represent non-zero elements as sorted pairs (index, value) and advance two pointers to find matching indices.

hints.title: Matched Product Accumulation
hints.text: When indices match, add value1 * value2 to the dot product accumulator and advance both pointers.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: L1, L2: number of non-zero elements in each vector
complexity.notes: Two-pointer traversal advances monotonically through sorted indices in linear time proportional to non-zero count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiplying all N dimensions takes O(N) operations even when 99.9% of entries are zero.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index-value pair storage scales with non-zero sparsity rather than full array length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sparse index representation paired with two-pointer merge or dictionary intersection.
